description: FREE lite SEO technical audit of a single web page URL. Runs the same 13 checks as audit_seo but returns top-line results only: 0-100 score, A-F grade, search-visibility risk level, the page title, check counts, and the titles of the top gaps — per-check evidence and fixes are capped. Use this to triage whether a page needs the full audit_seo report, or call audit_seo directly for the complete evidence-backed scan.
